problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization on R^d, with an attained minimum.

problem_class.label: strongly_convex
problem_class.details: Writing ||v||_W² = Σ_i w_i v_i², f is μ-strongly convex and 1-smooth in this weighted norm: μ||y−x||_W²/2 ≤ f(y)−f(x)−⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩ ≤ ||y−x||_W²/2. Here 0 < μ ≤ 1 and every w_i > 0.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DiagonalSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: spec.valid and both quadratic inequalities in spec.admissible.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query returns the exact full Euclidean gradient at any requested point, together with its function value. Replies are independent of the call index and oracle seed.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DiagonalSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, and oracle.answer equality in spec.admissible.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: Exact function values accompany gradients in the same oracle call; they incur no separate oracle charge.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DiagonalSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: spec.Reply and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Setup.numOracles and execute.

distinctive_assumptions.label: unknown_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The positive diagonal weights w and relative strong-convexity parameter μ are hidden. No bounds on individual weights or their ratios are public.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DiagonalSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, and spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm quantification.

distinctive_assumptions.label: non_euclidean_geometry
distinctive_assumptions.details: Both curvature bounds use the same unknown diagonal quadratic geometry W = diag(w), rather than a supplied scalar Euclidean smoothness constant.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is EuclideanSpace R (Fin d), with public integer dimension d ≥ 1.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only d, x0, and the exact attained optimum value fstar are public. The initial-gap bound Δ ≥ 0 and tolerance ε > 0 are hidden alongside w and μ. They determine the external oracle budget, but are not inputs to the algorithm constructor.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DiagonalSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence and execute.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point must satisfy f(output) − f(xstar) ≤ ε, where xstar is a global minimizer with f(xstar) = fstar.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, after execution with the supplied fixed oracle-call budget. Deterministic behavior is not required.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DiagonalSmoothStronglyConvex.lean: almost-everywhere quantifier in spec.successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm.law, Convergence, and execute.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The underlying objective class is smooth strongly convex minimization, but the information model combines unknown diagonal geometry and hidden curvature and accuracy parameters with a public exact optimum value and an externally imposed oracle budget.
